rule: admissible minimum: the least G(tau) / rho_bar_n(tau) over every coherence time tau, the lower of an exponential and a triangular frame-to-frame correlation, with G(tau) = max(tau / T_frame, 1) and rho_bar_n the mean correlation over the frame pairs of the n-frame dump that measured the coherent fraction
why: The coherent fraction is built from products of distinct frames, so a measured value implies coherence across frames; no coherence time prices it below this minimum.
note: A band whose pilot frequency channel was on a live node in the 2026-09 captures takes the 11-frame pilot dump's value (8.41); one without takes the 4-frame value (4.06).
